findings.summary: Removed mutable process-global support runtime configurators and added invocation-scoped capability and isolation gates.
Removed the Node Buffer ambient type leak from the browser-bridge public contract.
Frozen compatibility capability objects and made the boundary verifier reject mutable adapters.
Ownership conflicts for AgentDispatchResult, AgentSession, FileSnapshot, BrainstormResult, and other named types contradicted per-source generated ownership evidence.
Claims about runtime-boundary.ts, validateRuntimeConfig, skipped runtime tests, and codebase imports cited files and symbols absent from the repository.
Claims that compatibility adapters were marked removed or that generatedAt controls dependency order contradicted the migration ledger and generator implementation.
Corrected rollback semantics and added a two-commit clean-checkout gate proving the retained qualified S3 subject and S4 adapter re-entry.
Exact-subject ownership, timestamp, phantom-file, performance-average, and loose-evidence claims contradicted generated records and executable source.
Replaced a flaky scheduler elapsed-time proxy with direct old-holder-stale and new-lock-fresh assertions; all 16 file-lock tests pass.
Final exact-subject ownership and clock-skew claims contradicted the generated occurrence records, same-host test, and repository contents.
